entries.title: Prefer pure functions when possible
entries.content: Pure functions are easier to test and reason about. Avoid hidden global mutation.

entries.title: Never hardcode secrets
entries.content: Store secrets in environment/secret managers. Never commit keys to git or ship them to frontend.

entries.title: Layered architecture
entries.content: Separate API/adapters, domain logic, and persistence. Keep side effects at the edges.

entries.title: Testing pyramid
entries.content: Many fast unit tests, fewer integration tests, few end-to-end tests.
